items.title: 5.7 Archimedes ka usool aur tairna (floatation) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.7 with Figs. 5.8 to 5.10 and Examples 5.2 and 5.3 (PDF 101-104).

blocks.text: Hawa se bhara ghubbara (balloon) pani ke andar chhorein to foran oopar satah par aa jata hai. Lakri ka tukra pani ke andar chhorein to bhi yahi hota hai. Aap ne dekha hoga ke pani se bhara mug pani ke andar halka lagta hai, lekin pani se bahar nikalte hi bhari lagne lagta hai.

Do hazar saal se zyada pehle Yunani (Greek) scientist Archimedes ne dekha ke liquid ke andar rakhi cheez par oopar ki taraf ek force lagti hai. Is wajah se cheez ka weight kam lagta hai (apparent loss of weight, yani zahiri kami). Cheez par lagne wali is oopar ki force ko liquid ka upthrust kehte hain. Archimedes' principle kehta hai:

blocks.title: Archimedes' principle
blocks.text: Jab koi cheez liquid mein poori ya kuch hissa doobi ho, to us par oopar ki taraf upthrust force lagti hai jo us cheez ke hataye (displace kiye) hue liquid ke weight ke barabar hoti hai.

Ek thos (solid) cylinder lein jis ka cross-sectional area A aur oonchai h hai, aur woh liquid mein dooba hai (Fig. 5.8). Liquid ki satah se cylinder ke oopar wale face ki gehrai h₁ aur neeche wale face ki gehrai h₂ hai. To:

blocks.alt: Liquid ke bartan mein oopri raqba A aur oonchai h ka thos cylinder poora dooba hai. Baen taraf teer gehraiyan dikhate hain: h1 oopri satah tak, h2 neeche ki satah tak, aur un ke darmiyan h. Force F1 oopri satah par neeche aur force F2 neeche ki satah par oopar lagti hai; P1 oopri satah par dabao hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.8: Liquid mein doobe jism par upthrust hataye gaye liquid ke wazan ke barabar hai (kitab ki Figure 5.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche wala face zyada gehra hai (h₂ > h₁), is liye wahan pressure aur force F₂ zyada hai. Upthrust = F₂ − F₁ = ρgAh = ρgV. Kitab ki tasveer mein P₁ liquid ki satah ke paas likha hai, lekin text ke mutabiq P₁ gehrai h₁ par (cylinder ke oopar wale face par) pressure hai; is liye yahan P₁ wahin dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 5.8 mein P₁ liquid ki satah par likha hai, halan ke text mein P₁ gehrai h₁ par, yani cylinder ke oopar wale face par, pressure hai. Oopar diagram mein P₁ sahi jagah dikhaya gaya hai.
Agar gehrai h₁ aur h₂ par liquid ke pressure P₁ aur P₂ hon aur liquid ki density ρ ho, to:
Pressure P₁ ki wajah se liquid cylinder ke oopar wale face par force F₁ lagata hai, aur P₂ ki wajah se neeche wale face par force F₂. To:

blocks.latex: F_1 = P_1 A = \rho g h_1 A
\text{and}\quad F_2 = P_2 A = \rho g h_2 A

blocks.text: F₁ aur F₂ cylinder ke aamne saamne faces par lagti hain (F₁ neeche ki taraf, F₂ oopar ki taraf). Is liye net (kul) force F in dono ka farq hai. Cylinder par yahi net force liquid ka upthrust hai:

blocks.latex: F_2 - F_1 = \rho g h_2 A - \rho g h_1 A

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Archimedes taqreeban 287 BCE mein Sicily ke jazeere (island) par Syracuse shehar mein paida hue. Unhon ne apna riyazi (mathematical) kaam chhorne se inkar kiya to ek Roman sipahi ne unhen qatl kar diya.

Yahan Ah cylinder ka volume V hai, jo cylinder ke hataye hue liquid ke volume ke barabar hai; is liye ρgV hataye hue liquid ka weight hai. Yeh equation dikhati hai ke liquid mein doobi cheez par upthrust lagta hai jo hataye hue liquid ke weight ke barabar hai; yahi Archimedes' principle hai.

blocks.title: Example 5.2
blocks.problem: 10 cm side wala lakri ka cube pani mein poora dubaya gaya hai. Us par pani ka upthrust nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: side L = 10 cm = 0.1 m
Pani ki density ρ = 1000 kg m⁻³; upthrust F = ?
blocks.answer: Lakri ke cube par pani ka upthrust 9.8 N hai.

blocks.text: Floatation (tairna)

Agar cheez ka weight us par lagne wale upthrust se zyada ho to cheez doob jati hai. Agar weight upthrust ke barabar ya kam ho to cheez tairti hai. Jab cheez fluid mein tair rahi ho to us par upthrust us ke weight ke barabar hota hai. Tairti cheez kuch hissa hi doobi ho sakti hai. Upthrust hamesha cheez ke hataye hue fluid ke weight ke barabar hota hai. Yahi principle of floatation (tairne ka usool) hai:

blocks.title: Principle of floatation
blocks.text: Tairti hui cheez utna fluid hatati hai jis ka weight cheez ke apne weight ke barabar ho.
Archimedes' principle liquids aur gases dono par lagu hota hai. Rozmarra zindagi mein is ke bohat se istemal hain.
Applications (istemal)
Archimedes' principle ke kuch ahem istemal yeh hain:
1. Hot-air balloon

Hot-air balloon hawa mein is liye uthta aur tairta hai ke garam hawa wale balloon ki density aas paas ki hawa se kam hoti hai. Jab balloon par buoyant force (upthrust) us ke weight se zyada ho jaye to woh oopar uthne lagta hai. Balloon mein garam hawa ki miqdar kam ya zyada kar ke yeh control kiya jata hai.
2. Pani par tairta lakri ka block

Lakri ka block pani par tairta hai, kyun ke block jitne volume ke pani ka weight block ke weight se zyada hai. Tairne ke usool ke mutabiq jism tab tairta hai jab kuch hissa ya poora doobne par us ka hataya hua pani us ke weight ke barabar ho jaye.
3. Ships aur boats (jahaz aur kashtiyan)

Jahaz aur kashtiyan bhi isi tairne ke usool par banai jati hain. Yeh musafir aur saman pani par le jati hain. Agar musafiron aur saman samet jahaz ka weight pani ke upthrust se zyada ho jaye to woh doob jayega.
4. Submarine (aabdoz)
Submarine isi usool se pani ke oopar bhi chal sakti hai aur pani ke neeche bhi.

Jab submarine ke volume ke barabar pani ka weight us ke apne weight se zyada ho to woh pani par tairti hai; us waqt woh jahaz jaisi hai aur us ka kuch hissa pani se oopar rehta hai. Us mein tanks hote hain jinhen samandar ke pani se bhara aur khali kiya ja sakta hai. Tanks mein pani bharne se submarine ka weight barhta hai. Jaise hi weight upthrust se zyada hota hai, submarine pani mein ghota lagati (dive karti) hai aur neeche rehti hai. Oopar aane ke liye tanks se pani nikal diya jata hai.

blocks.alt: Pehloo se peeli submarine, us ke hisson tak lakeerein: tower ke oopar periscope aur antenna, peechhe propeller, aage sonar aur dhanche (hull) par gol khirkiyon (portholes) ki qatar.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.10(b): Submarine (kitab ki Figure 5.10(b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Example 5.3
blocks.problem: Ek khali meteorological (mausam napne wala) balloon ka weight 80 N hai. Is mein 10 cubic metre hydrogen bhari jati hai. Balloon apne weight ke ilawa zyada se zyada kitna saman utha sakta hai? Hydrogen ki density 0.09 kg m⁻³ aur hawa ki density 1.3 kg m⁻³ hai.
steps: Diya gaya: balloon ka weight w = 80 N; hydrogen ka volume V = 10 m³; hydrogen ki density ρ₁ = 0.09 kg m⁻³; hawa ki density ρ₂ = 1.3 kg m⁻³. Hydrogen ka weight w₁ = ?; saman ka weight w₂ = ?
Upthrust F = hataye hui hawa ka weight = ρ₂gV = 1.3 kg m⁻³ × 9.8 m s⁻² × 10 m³ = 127.4 N
Hydrogen ka weight w₁ = ρ₁Vg = 0.09 kg m⁻³ × 10 m³ × 9.8 m s⁻² = 8.82 N
Saman uthane ke liye kul weight upthrust F se zyada nahi hona chahiye: w + w₁ + w₂ = F
blocks.answer: Balloon apne weight ke ilawa taqreeban 38.6 N (kitab ke hisaab mein 38 N) saman utha sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki aakhri line kehti hai ke balloon 41 N utha sakta hai, magar usi hal mein w₂ = 127.4 − 80 − 8.82 = 38.58 N, yani taqreeban 38.6 N nikalta hai (kitab ne 38 N likha). Sahi jawab taqreeban 38.6 N hai, 41 N nahi. Kitab ki ek line (80 N + 8.82 N + w₁ = 127.4 N) mein w₂ ki jagah w₁ chhapa hai; wahan w₂ hona chahiye.

blocks.caption: Floatation ke istemal
rows: garam hawa aas paas ki hawa se kam ghani; buoyant force weight se zyada
barabar volume ke pani ka weight block se zyada
andar se khokhla hull apne weight ke barabar pani hata deta hai; upthrust se zyada laadne par doobta hai
tanks mein samandar ka pani bharne se weight upthrust se zyada: ghota; khali karne se oopar

blocks.prompt: 600 kg m⁻³ density ka 10 kg lakri ka block pani par tair raha hai. Us par buoyant force kitni hai, aur block ka kitna hissa pani mein dooba hai? Patthar ka weight hawa ke muqable pani mein kam kyun lagta hai?
blocks.explanation: Tairti cheez apne weight ke barabar fluid hatati hai, is liye buoyant force = weight = 10 × 9.8 = 98 N. Doobe hisse ka volume = 98 / (1000 × 9.8) = 0.01 m³, jab ke block ka kul volume = 10/600 ≈ 0.0167 m³; is liye block ka 60% hissa dooba hai. Pani mein patthar par oopar ki taraf upthrust lagta hai jo us ke weight ka kuch hissa sambhal leta hai, is liye us ka weight hataye hue pani ke weight jitna kam lagta hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Upthrust = F₂ − F₁ = ρgA(h₂ − h₁) = ρgV = hataye hue liquid ka weight (Archimedes' principle).
Weight upthrust se zyada: doobta hai; barabar ya kam: tairta hai. Tairti cheez apne weight ke barabar fluid hatati hai (floatation); yeh gases par bhi lagu hai.
Istemal: hot-air balloon, lakri ka block, jahaz aur kashtiyan, submarine (tanks bhar kar ghota).
Example 5.2: 10 cm cube par 9.8 N. Example 5.3: balloon taqreeban 38.6 N uthata hai (kitab mein 38 N aur 41 N).
